⚡ perf: add first block gas pre-calculation optimization

Optimize gas calculation by pre-computing the gas cost for the first
basic block of bytecode during dispatch initialization. This reduces
runtime overhead by batching gas calculations for straight-line code.

The optimization scans bytecode until hitting a terminator instruction
(JUMP, JUMPI, STOP, RETURN, etc.) or JUMPDEST, accumulating gas costs
that can be charged as a single operation.

🐛 fix: prevent integer overflow in depth decrement

Add safety check to prevent integer underflow when decrementing
the call depth counter. This fixes a panic that could occur when
depth is already 0.

The fix ensures depth is only decremented if it's greater than 0,
preventing the underflow that was causing test failures.
